wallet_interaction.preview_unavailable_warning: We couldn't check what this transaction does because the preview service is temporarily unavailable. Only approve if you trust the scene that requested it.
wallet_interaction.acknowledge_preview_unavailable: I understand the preview is unavailable and I'm approving without seeing what this transaction does
wallet_interaction.review_restarted_notice: Your wallet's network changed or couldn't be verified, so this transaction was reviewed again on the current network.

transaction_dialog.title: Confirm Transaction
transaction_dialog.simulation_loading: Checking what this transaction will do…
transaction_dialog.details_unavailable: A preview of this transaction isn't available. Only continue if you trust the scene.
transaction_dialog.revert_title: This transaction is likely to fail
transaction_dialog.revert_description: It is expected to revert if submitted{reason}
transaction_dialog.gas_covered: Gas fees are covered by Decentraland.
transaction_dialog.no_changes: This transaction doesn't move any of your assets or grant any permissions. It may still change settings or roles the preview can't show.
transaction_dialog.approval_access_revoked: can no longer access your {name} collection
transaction_dialog.acknowledge_risk: I understand this grants access to my assets
transaction_dialog.acknowledge_no_visible_effects: I understand the preview shows no changes to my assets and this may still change settings or roles I can't see here
transaction_dialog.summary_transaction: Your wallet will send this transaction now.
transaction_dialog.summary_signature: Your wallet will sign this request now.

signature.title: Confirm signature
signature.description: Review what you are about to sign.
signature.meta_tx_notice: This signature authorizes the contract to run this action on your behalf. It doesn't expire and can be submitted later by the app that requested it.
signature.meta_tx_reverted: This action fails right now, so its effects couldn't be previewed. Only sign it if you expect it to work later.
signature.acknowledge_unverified: I understand the effects of this signature couldn't be verified

unverified.intro_transaction: This isn't a call to a Decentraland contract, so Decentraland can't check what it does.
unverified.intro_native_transfer: This sends {amount} {symbol} to the address below.
unverified.intro_meta_transaction: This signature lets the contract below run an action on your behalf. Decentraland can't check what that action does.
unverified.intro_signature: Decentraland can't check what this signature will be used for.
unverified.warning_transaction_assets: It runs from your account and can move any assets or permissions your account holds.
unverified.warning_transaction_final: Once sent, it can't be undone.
unverified.warning_meta_tx_bearer: Anyone who holds the signature can submit it, at any time.
unverified.warning_meta_tx_unknown_call: It runs an action Decentraland can't read, on a contract Decentraland doesn't recognize.
unverified.warning_signature_login: It could log you in to another site or app as you.
unverified.warning_signature_orders: It could authorize an off-chain order, listing or spending permission over your assets.
unverified.warning_signature_unverifiable: What is shown here can't be checked against what it does.
unverified.trust_scene: Only continue if you trust the scene that asked for it.
unverified.advanced_hint_transaction: This is exactly what your wallet will send.
unverified.advanced_hint_signature: This is exactly what your wallet will sign.
unverified.advanced_hint_typed_data: This is the typed data as your wallet will read it. It signs only the fields the types declare.
unverified.message_unreadable: This message isn't readable text. The exact bytes are under Advanced.
unverified.message_scroll_hint: Scroll to the end of the message before continuing.
unverified.acknowledge_transaction: I understand Decentraland can't check this transaction and I'm sending it anyway
unverified.acknowledge_native_transfer: I understand I'm sending {amount} {symbol} and this can't be undone
unverified.acknowledge_meta_transaction: I understand this signature lets the contract act for me at any time and its effects can't be checked
unverified.acknowledge_signature: I understand Decentraland can't check what this signature authorizes

timeout.title: Looks like you took too long and the request has expired.
timeout.subtitle: If the expiration time is still running in the Explorer app, check your computer's time to see if it's set correctly.
timeout.description: Please return to Decentraland's {explorerText} to try again.

different_account.title: Looks like you are connected with a different account.
different_account.description: Please change your wallet account to the one connected to the {explorerText}.

outdated_client_error.title: Your app needs an update
outdated_client_error.description: This version of {explorerText} uses a sign-in method that is no longer supported. Please update to the latest version and sign in again.

wallet_interaction_complete.title: Wallet interaction complete
wallet_interaction_complete.description: The action has been executed successfully.

denied_wallet_interaction.title: Was this action not initiated by you?
denied_wallet_interaction.description: If this action was not initiated by you, dismiss this message.

signing_error.title: There was an error while trying to submit the request.
signing_error.description: Return to the {explorerText} to try again, or contact support if the error persists.
signing_error.malformed_transaction: This transaction was refused: it targets a Decentraland contract but isn't shaped like a Decentraland action, so it can't be reviewed safely.
signing_error.malformed_signature: This signature was refused: it isn't shaped like anything a Decentraland contract signs, so it can't be reviewed safely.
signing_error.unsupported_contract: This request was refused: it reaches a contract Decentraland doesn't own, so what it does can't be reviewed here.
signing_error.impersonated_sign_in: This request was refused: it tried to sign a Decentraland login, which would let the scene act as you.
signing_error.wallet_error: Your wallet could not complete the request.

lookup_unavailable.title: We couldn't verify this request yet
lookup_unavailable.description: Decentraland's network couldn't be reached to check the contract this request targets. Nothing was signed or sent, and the request is still waiting. Try again in a moment.

recover_error.title: There was an error recovering the request...
recover_error.description: The request is not available anymore. Feel free to create a new one and try again. If the expiration time is still running in the Explorer app, check your computer's time to see if it's set correctly.

client_login_error.title: We couldn't complete your sign in
client_login_error.description: Something went wrong while finishing your sign in. Please try again.

continue_in_app.redirect_countdown: You will be redirected to {explorerText} in {countdown}...
continue_in_app.app_not_launched: The application could not be launched. Please make sure {explorerText} is installed and try again.
